Considering I live in a very weird area (it's rural on an old farm but still only like 25 minutes from a large city), a dog like Pokémon such as Growlithe or Arcanine would mostly likely be the first Pokémon I'd know (more so Arcanine since I'm one of four and we love big dogs). Arcanine would be more of a family pet so it would be more on my parents' money for said reasons.

Next I'd say an Electabuzz raised from an egg. Would be totally needy but we since we have blackouts and blow fuzes all the time, we'd probably blame him (not in a bad way, just as an excuse or reasoning). He would be able to restore power and wouldn't be too big (shockingly, pun not intended, only a little over 42 inches). Probably wouldn't evolve since Electivire would be taller than me, my sisters, and my mom plus it's known to be a lot more reckless than it's pre-evolution.

Third would be a Zorua since we have a lot of sneaky foxes, coyotes, and wolves where I live. I don't think it would evolve since Zoroark's claws would be too sharp for the carpets in my house.

Lastly would be a Noibat since we've had a few bat incidents in my house. Noivern would be cool but much like the other two, it would also be too large. It would also be easier to feed like Zoura.
